UPSC Assistant Professor Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 34 posts. Online applying process for UPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 has started from 08 March 2025 & the candidates can apply till 27 March 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 08 March 2025
  • Application Start Date : 08 March 2025
  • Last Date : 27 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 March 2025
  • Re Print Form Last Date : 28 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • PH (Divyang) : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
